item.title: Terry Tao (AGMAI): Disadvantages of Designating Mathematicians for AI Output Releases
item.description: AGMAI argues AI labs should not hand AI-generated math output to designated insiders first — it creates unequal access, denied agency and borrowed reputation; release publicly with better exposition instead.

item.title: SemiAnalysis: Amazon’s Trainium Takes a Strike at the Training King
item.description: Hands-on Trainium3 testing suggests AWS is becoming a credible training challenger as it moves to a first-class native PyTorch experience, though it is still not as mature as the CUDA ecosystem.

item.title: Nathan Lambert: Podcast: Kimi K3.1 Pro, the new cyber reality, and Muse musings
item.description: Lambert and Florian Brand unpack a messy AI week: Kimi K3.1 Pro's mixed reception despite strong benchmarks, whether open-weight cyber risk was misjudged, and Muse musings.
